name: mytex-document-symbol-provider
description: Provides document symbol support for .mytex files.

mytex.llm.apiEndpoint.description: The API endpoint for the OpenAI-compatible LLM service.

mytex.llm.model.description: The model name to use for summarization.

mytex.llm.prompt.default:
You are a highly skilled assistant specialized in summarizing academic texts. I will provide you with the full text of an introduction section and the number of paragraphs it contains. Your task is to return a JSON array where each element is a concise summary (under 15 words) for the corresponding paragraph. Do not include any explanations or introductory text outside of the JSON array. The full text has {{numparagraphs}} paragraphs.

Full Text:
"""
{{fulltext}}
"""
mytex.llm.prompt.markdownDescription:
The Mustache template for the prompt. 

Available variables: 
- `{{fulltext}}`: The entire text of the document. 
- `{{numparagraphs}}`: The number of paragraphs detected.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
